marc:datafield.marc:subfield: LAIN daRI yaNg LAIN. EPISOD 6. SIRI 8.

Contains 3 segments: SEGMENT 1 This week's showcase revolves around the trend of using sand to create sculptures of monuments, statues, and legendary landmarks, held for the very first time in Malaysia. This sculptural art was previously held in European countries and America about 100 years ago. SEGMENT 2 Every birth marks the growth of a lineage; this showcase relates to a family with many children as well as twins. Next, it revolves around the story of a man who is now over a century old. There is a secret behind each of these stories. SEGMENT 3 The various uses of coconut shells to produce decorative items for beautifying a home. This is done by a resident in Chalok Barat, Setiu, Terengganu, to further enhance the landscape of their residence.
